releases.name: Reindr 0.0.3: Predictable local ports
releases.body:
## Patch versions
- @nicodes/reindr-opencode: 0.0.3
- @nicodes/reindr-core: 0.0.2
- Claude Code marketplace plugin: 0.0.2

## Port policy
- With no port configured, start at 7676 and try 7677, 7678, and so on when occupied.
- Explicit REINDR_PORT or OpenCode plugin port settings are exact: an occupied port reports an error and does not fall back.
- Explicit port 0 still asks the OS to assign an available port.
- Only EADDRINUSE triggers default-port retries; other errors fail immediately. Scanning stops at 65535 without wrapping.
- Claude startup failures now surface immediately in reindr_open and reindr_status.

## Validation
40 tests, typechecks, builds, package dry runs, strict Claude validation, release dry run, and trusted npm publishing passed. Real Bun and Node collision checks verified sequential selection and explicit-port errors. OpenCode depends on core ^0.0.2 so both packages use the same configuration contract.

## Upgrade
Update the OpenCode plugin to @nicodes/reindr-opencode@0.0.3 and restart OpenCode. Leave the port unset for automatic sequential fallback; explicitly setting 7676 requests that exact port only. Update the Claude marketplace/plugin for Claude support.

PR: https://github.com/nicodes/reindr/pull/10
Publish workflow: https://github.com/nicodes/reindr/actions/runs/34525872664

releases.name: OpenCode 0.0.2: Tabbed workspaces
releases.body:
## OpenCode adapter patch release
Published: @nicodes/reindr-opencode@0.0.2. Core and the Claude Code plugin remain at 0.0.1.

### Workspace
- Multiple named HTML canvas tabs per session, displayed in the main header.
- Persistent host-owned agent controls to the right of session navigation, with independent navigation and agent icon toggles.
- Canvas state and agent drafts survive panel toggles and tab switches.
- Saved canvases render automatically inside the existing sandbox, with no activation prompt.
- Existing single-file sessions remain supported; new canvases default to blank content rather than controller HTML.

### Fixes
- Connected model discovery works with large provider catalogs.
- Idle sessions omitted from OpenCode status responses correctly dispatch queued prompts.
- Per-tab capabilities and trusted canvas-interaction restrictions remain enforced.

### Validation
22 automated tests, typechecks, builds, package dry runs, strict Claude manifest validation, and manual real OpenCode desktop/mobile integration passed. Release dry run and npm trusted publishing succeeded.

### Install
Use @nicodes/reindr-opencode@0.0.2 in the OpenCode plugin list, then quit and restart OpenCode. Do not load both the local development adapter and the npm adapter in the same instance.

PR: https://github.com/nicodes/reindr/pull/9
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nicodes/reindr-opencode/v/0.0.2
Publish workflow: https://github.com/nicodes/reindr/actions/runs/34445258172
